papers.title: Black-box Explanation of Object Detectors via Saliency Maps
papers.review: Abstract,introduction and rendered page3 read. D-RISE uses input masking and localization/category similarity; prior perturbation explanations include occlusion,noise,inpainting and blur. Context outside boxes can be important.
papers.overlap: Input deletion and confidence-drop explanations for YOLO/object detectors are established. Candidate56 is not D-RISE reproduction or a new attribution method.

papers.title: FACTOR: Counterfactual Training-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
papers.review: Abstract,introduction and rendered page3 read. Paired attribute perturbations, spatial prediction alignment and region sensitivity support training-free logit calibration in open-vocabulary detection.
papers.overlap: Paired perturbation reliability and score recalibration are established; within-box texture deletion versus equal-area nearby control is only a diagnostic distinction, not sufficient novelty.

papers.title: Reading Decoder Trajectories: Training-Free Counterfactual Query-Trajectory Reliability for Small-Object Detection
papers.review: Abstract,introduction and rendered page3 read. Counterfactual scale branch reads intermediate decoder spatial/semantic trajectories and cross-scale conflicts before reliability routing and NMS.
papers.overlap: Frozen small-object scale activation and internal-query reliability already have a close prior. YOLO fixed-anchor own/sham deletion is not a decoder-trajectory implementation; difference alone does not establish novelty.
